chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Shadhawayh al-Mu'addab (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Jami' al-Himyari narrated to us, from his father, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Ziyad, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

May God have mercy on a person who helps his father in his righteousness. May God have mercy on a father who helps his child in his righteousness. May God have mercy on a neighbour who helps his neighbour in his righteousness. May God have mercy on a companion who helps his companion in his righteousness. May God have mercy on an acquaintance who helps his acquaintance in his righteousness. May God have mercy on a man who helps his ruler in his righteousness.

key_terms.رحم الله: Rahima Allah: May God have mercy

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about helping others in their righteousness?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) invokes divine mercy upon six categories of people who actively help others in performing righteous deeds: children helping parents, parents helping children, neighbours, companions, acquaintances, and subjects helping their rulers. This teaching, delivered in the context of communal guidance, emphasizes that righteousness is not merely an individual pursuit but a collective responsibility, and that every social relationship carries a duty of mutual moral support.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Shadhuwayh al-Mu’addab (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far b. Jami` al-Himyari from his father from Harun b. Muslim from Mas`ada b. Ziyad from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

May Allah have mercy on a man who helps his father in his righteousness. May Allah have mercy on a father who helps his child in his righteousness. May Allah have mercy on a neighbour who helps his neighbour in his righteousness. May Allah have mercy on a friend who helps his friend in his righteousness. May Allah have mercy on an acquaintance that helps his acquaintance in his righteousness. May Allah have mercy on a man who helps his ruler in his righteousness.
